title: Cables, Cords & Power Packs — video poster

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Use the product itself to organize a message so the viewer understands the subject before reading details.
strategic_value: The playful cable arrangement can make a technical accessory topic feel less forbidding in Cox retail content.
demonstration: The supplied video poster arranges multicolored cables in a circular border around a bold black title on white. No motion is observable in the saved still.
practical_value: Leave a clear central reading area when arranging detailed objects into a framing shape.

content_islands.name: Cable ring
content_islands.spec: Arrange the visible cables and connectors around a large circular opening on a white field.

content_islands.name: Central title
content_islands.spec: Center the two-line black title inside the ring without overlapping the connectors.
